data.name: Cli.Help
data.value:
Zentra from the command line (as administrator): Zentra.exe --diagnose [--inventory] [--report <folder>] [--client <name>] Zentra.exe --preset <file.json|estandar> [--diagnose] [--inventory] [--report <folder>] [--client <name>] [--silent] [--remove-apps] [--allow-risky] Zentra.exe --verify <report folder> Zentra.exe --remove-followup
--diagnose Measure and diagnose. With --preset: before and after. --preset Apply a preset. Always previewed, always after a restore point. --inventory Also write the installed programs and the Windows activation (read only). --report Copy session.json, the PDF, ZENTRA-SHA256.txt, the inventory and zentra-cli.txt to that folder. --client Client name for the report. --silent Do not ask for confirmation. --remove-apps Also remove the preset's apps (cannot be undone). --keep-apps Keep the apps (the default; still accepted). --allow-risky Allow Expert settings, if the preset allows them too. --verify Check the report files against ZENTRA-SHA256.txt. Changes nothing. --remove-followup Delete the follow-up task and its copy of Zentra (the results stay).
Exit codes: 0 done, 1 arguments, 2 invalid preset, 3 not administrator, 4 no restore point, 5 done with failures, 6 cancelled, 7 report changed or missing, 10 unexpected error. In PowerShell, to wait for it: Start-Process Zentra.exe -ArgumentList '--diagnose' -Wait -PassThru

data.value: Uninstalls Edge with its own uninstaller. Keeps the client's favorites and passwords and does not touch WebView2, which other apps need. Windows Update may put it back; to reinstall it: winget install Microsoft.Edge.

data.name: Optimizer.Expert.DisableBitLocker.ShortDescription

data.name: Optimizer.Expert.DisableSearchIndexing.ShortDescription
data.value: Stops and disables the search service. The disk works less (useful on mechanical disks), but searching files in Explorer and Start becomes much slower. Can be reverted.

data.name: Optimizer.Expert.DisableReservedStorage.ShortDescription
data.value: Frees the 7 to 10 GB Windows keeps for updates. Only worth it on small disks; turn it back on before a big Windows update. Can be reverted.

data.name: Optimizer.Expert.DisableUnsignedRdpWarning.ShortDescription

data.name: Optimizer.SecurityAndPrivacy.DisableEdgeTelemetryAndAds.ShortDescription

data.name: Optimizer.SecurityAndPrivacy.DisableWpbt.ShortDescription
data.value: Stops the BIOS from installing the maker's programs at every boot without asking. On some laptops it also turns off their anti-theft service.

data.name: Optimizer.UserExperience.DetailedBlueScreen.ShortDescription
data.value: If Windows crashes, the blue screen shows the technical details of the error instead of the sad face. Useful for diagnosis.

data.value: Fixes flicker, black screens and video driver resets on some graphics cards. Applies after a restart. Use it only if the PC has those symptoms.
